description: This Java source file defines the WorkEffortSearchSession class, which manages search options, constraints, and session state for work effort searches within the OFBiz framework. It includes nested classes for search options, methods for processing search parameters, and session management utilities.

classes.name: WorkEffortSearchSession
classes.description: Utility class for managing work effort search session state, constraints, and options within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: WorkEffortSearchOptions
classes.description: Serializable class encapsulating search constraints, sort order, view index, and size for work effort searches, with methods to manipulate and retrieve these options from session.

methods.name: getWorkEffortSearchOptions
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the current WorkEffortSearchOptions object from the session.

methods.name: processSearchParameters
methods.description: Processes incoming search parameters from a request, updating session search constraints, sort order, and view settings accordingly.

methods.name: searchAddConstraint
methods.description: Adds a search constraint to the session's current search options.

methods.name: searchSetSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order for the current search session.

methods.name: getSearchOptionsHistoryList
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the list of previous search options stored in the session.

methods.name: searchGetConstraintStrings
methods.description: Returns a list of human-readable constraint descriptions for the current search.

methods.name: searchGetSortOrderString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the current sort order.

methods.name: checkSaveSearchOptionsHistory
methods.description: Saves the current search options to history if they have changed.

methods.name: searchRemoveConstraint
methods.description: Removes a constraint at a specified index from the current search options.

methods.name: searchClear
methods.description: Clears all current search constraints and options.
